output.reason: [ev-28c263f19767] says that by default, the retry policy no longer retries on 503, and that setting "EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY" to false restores the old behaviour. So the structure is right: an environment is exposed unless that variable is false, and it is shielded when the variable is false. The proposal is wrong on the value it matches: it compares against the string "\"false\"", with the quote marks included. The quotes in the release note only set off the variable's name, so a real setting of false would not match the proposal's condition. The value to match is the plain string false.

correction.statement: Istio's default retry policy no longer retries on 503. This affects every environment where the EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY environment variable is not set to false. Environments that set it to false keep the old behaviour, and the release note says this flag is temporary.
